behavior: packages.json parses and Tool.AssetName resolves per-OS assets (incl. sops's irregular Windows name) with errors on missing/invalid catalog
dotf tools list prints the catalog with the current-OS asset

dotf tools install downloads the pinned release asset, verifies its sha256 against the release checksums, and places it in ~/.local/bin; reconcile is pin-as-minimum (install/upgrade/skip, never downgrade); a checksum mismatch or download failure leaves Dest untouched
verification: go -C cli test ./internal/tools/... -run TestInstall; go -C cli test ./internal/tools/... -run TestDecideAction
evidence: TestInstall_{Fresh,ChecksumMismatch,MissingChecksumEntry,DownloadFailure,UnsupportedOS,SkipWhenAtOrAbovePin,UpgradeWhenBelowPin,WindowsBinaryName}, TestDecideAction; live smoke: sops 3.13.1 installed + skip on re-run

behavior: dotf tools install [name] selects all/one catalog tool, installs best-effort (aggregate failures, exit non-zero if any failed), and errors clearly on an unknown tool or absent packages.json; setup deploys packages.json and invokes the installer non-fatally
